Question
========
When measuring the performance of a system, what is the name of the capacity threshold at which the performance gain starts to decrease, i.e. is not linear anymore?


Answerlist
----------
* Knee capacity
* Nominal capacity
* Useable capacity
* Limit capacity

Solution
========
The knee is the point of the curve where adding resources stops paying off linearly.

Answerlist
----------
* 1. The knee is exactly the point where the curve leaves its linear regime.
* 0. The nominal capacity is the ideal linear scaling, not the point where it is left.
* 0. The useable capacity is bounded by a response time requirement.
* 0. This is not one of the capacity definitions seen in the course.
